import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
template_df = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Labels distribution - Train: {train_df['Insult'].value_counts().to_dict()}")


def clean_text(text):
    """Clean text: remove surrounding quotes, escape chars, normalize"""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    # Remove surrounding double quotes and inner escapes
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    text = text.replace("\\n", " ")
    text = text.replace('\\"', '"').replace("\n", " ")
    text = text.replace("\r", "")
    return text.strip()


train_comments = (
    train_df["Comment"]
    .apply(lambda x: clean_text(x) if pd.notnull(x) else "")
    .astype(str)
)
train_labels = train_df["Insult"]
if train_labels.isna().any():
    train_labels = train_labels.fillna(0)

X_train_raw, X_val_raw, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_comments,
    train_labels,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_labels,
    shuffle=False,
)

X_val_clean = [clean_text(x) if pd.notnull(x) else "" for x in X_val_raw]
X_test_clean = [clean_text(x) if pd.notnull(x) else "" for x in test_df["Comment"]]

# Create TF-IDF vectorizers with simpler settings
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=2000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    smooth_idf=True,
    analyzer="word",
    strip_accents=None,
)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=1000,
    ngram_range=(2, 3),
    min_df=2,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    smooth_idf=True,
    analyzer="char_wb",
    strip_accents=None,
)

# Fit on training data only (not validation!)
X_train_clean = X_train_raw
word_features = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)
char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_clean)

# Transform val and test sets
word_val_features = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
char_val_features = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val_clean)
word_test_features = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_clean)
char_test_features = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_clean)

# Stack features horizontally while keeping sparse format
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train_stacked = hstack([word_features, char_features])
X_val_stacked = hstack([word_val_features, char_val_features])
X_test_stacked = hstack([word_test_features, char_test_features])

# Calculate class weight
pos_ratio = len(y_train[y_train == 1]) / len(y_train[y_train == 0])
print(f"Pos ratio: {pos_ratio:.4f}, scale_pos_weight: {pos_ratio:.2f}")

# Initialize LightGBM classifier with simpler hyperparameters
lightgbm_classifier = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.7,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    scale_pos_weight=pos_ratio,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    num_leaves=31,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    eval_set=[(X_val_stacked, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],  # Disable logging
)

# Fit with early stopping to reduce training time
try:
    lightgbm_classifier.fit(X_train_stacked, y_train)

    # Validate on held-out set (model NEVER trained on this data)
    val_pred_proba = lightgbm_classifier.predict_proba(X_val_stacked)[:, 1]
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred_proba)
    print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC on held-out set: {val_auc:.4f}")

    # Apply calibration via sigmoid scaling if needed for confidence scores
    calibrated_lgbm = CalibratedClassifierCV(
        lightgbm_classifier, method="sigmoid", cv=3
    )
    try:
        calibrated_lgbm.fit(X_train_stacked, y_train)
        test_predictions = calibrated_lgbm.predict_proba(X_test_stacked)[:, 1]

        # If calibration fails or takes too long, fall back to raw predictions
    except:
        test_predictions = lightgbm_classifier.predict_proba(X_test_stacked)[:, 1]

    test_predictions = np.clip(test_predictions, 0, 1)

    print(f"Generated predictions for {len(test_predictions)} test samples")
    print(
        f"Prediction range: [{test_predictions.min():.4f}, {test_predictions.max():.4f}]"
    )

    # Save submission file
    submission_df = template_df.copy()
    submission_df.loc[:, "prediction"] = test_predictions

    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)

    print("=" * 50)
